subject.title: [优化建议] 添加结构化错误处理和智能重试机制

question: Which installer npm failures should OpenClaw automatically retry or repair, and where should it only print remediation guidance?
rationale: The source and related macOS report show a real diagnostics gap, but cross-platform npm prefix repair, transient-network retries, and optional setup-probe strictness can change install behavior and need maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Define a narrow policy, then implement
options.body: Classify known npm failures, retry only transient idempotent network failures, and add platform-specific EACCES guidance or repair with focused Bash and PowerShell tests.

options.title: Guidance-only diagnostics
options.body: Keep install behavior mostly unchanged but improve EACCES, ENOSPC, EBADENGINE, and network-error messages with clear next commands and docs links.

options.title: Keep current partial diagnostics
options.body: Accept current npm code/syscall/errno output and targeted cleanup retries without adding a broader installer error policy.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow policy, then implement
recommendation.body: Classify known npm failures, retry only transient idempotent network failures, and add platform-specific EACCES guidance or repair with focused Bash and PowerShell tests.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the broadest recent history across the Bash installer, PowerShell installer, Docker setup, and installer tests implicated by this choice.
